'''Moon on the Water''' is a [[sword form]]. Other than the name, nothing is known about it. It was used in the duel between [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[The Blood|High Lord]] [[Turak Aladon]]. The opposing side assumed [[The Wood Grouse Dances]].{{ref/book|2|45}} Rand later tried to use this form against [[Ishamael|Ba'alzamon]] during the battle in the sky over [[Falme]].{{ref/book|2|47}}
